第一三章 药鼎幻身
房间里飘着淡淡的幽香，橘黄的灯光下，一名身材火爆的美女随着音乐热辣起舞。酥胸挺送，腰肢摆动，高挑曼妙的躯体如水蛇般柔媚地扭动着，凸凹有致的妙处在粉红轻纱下若隐若现。
音乐渐趋柔靡，充满诱惑的暧昧气息萦绕流转。
看着这名刚从酒吧里勾搭回来不久的美女，聂空兴致勃勃，冲着她胸脯做了个揉捏的手势。美女娇媚地咯咯一笑，舞着舞着便来到了聂空身前，修长的美腿分开，居然就这么跨坐在了聂空的大腿上。
丰盈的双峰不时蹭过聂空胸膛，咿咿呀呀的吟叫声配合地从美女如火的红唇中吐露出来。
“真是迷死人不偿命的小妖精。”
美女的叫声就像是催情剂，聂空下边反应越发激烈，忍不住低吼一声，把美女按倒床上。可就在他化身禽兽准备把美女正法时，身下性感妖娆的娇躯突然一阵闪烁，下一刻，美女竟变成了布裙木钗、清纯秀丽的少女。
“叔叔？”
美少女面靥通红，水汪汪的眸子里满是惊慌羞怯，似乎在质问聂空为什么会变得这么禽兽？
“嫂嫂？花眉？”
定睛一看，聂空吓得一个激灵，如遭蛇吻，猛地翻身弹跳起来，转眼一看，才发现自己正坐在床上，窗子里透着白蒙蒙的亮光，房间里影影绰绰的，依稀可以分辨出桌椅的影子，正是他在聂家的那间卧室。
居然做了个春梦，看来是在异世的这几天生活太紧张了！聂空揉揉眼眶，苦笑着摇了摇头。
蓦地，脑海中“叮铃铃”脆响，一个非常机械的声音随即传来：“宠物‘紫罗幻灵香’成功升级至一阶，激活宠物背包四格，领悟一阶同体战斗技能‘花爆’，领悟同体辅助技能‘药鼎幻身’。”
香香升级了？
聂空怔了怔，心念一动，灵神三窍之间“瑶池穴”内的情形顿时在脑中显现出来：紫罗幻灵香种子已经长成了一株小嫩苗，底部三根小须分别贴在窍穴上，细细的茎干上顶着一片小叶子，嫩绿中透着淡淡的紫色。
在聂空的“注视”下，小家伙欢快地摇动着仅有的那片小叶子，一股勃勃的生机透散开来。
“小家伙长得可够快的。”
聂空面露惊喜。
前天清晨小家伙吸收大量药力后陷入沉眠，之后便没半点动静，聂空还以为它吸收太多，被撑出问题来了，一直有些担心，没想到两天过去，小家伙再次苏醒来时，竟已升级到了一阶。
高兴了好一阵子，聂空才回想起刚才脑海中的那道声音。

按照妖魔的标准，一阶，应该就是十级。一阶技能，应该就是从十级到二十级之间的技能。
药师职业的一阶技能共有四个：疗伤术、聚元术、固体术和裂空斩。疗伤术，是用来恢复HP的；聚元术，可消耗少量HP瞬间加满MP；固体术，能给自己增加防御；裂空斩，则是药师职业二十级以前唯一的攻击技能。至于“药鼎幻身”，却是来源于生活职业“炼药”，十级时可以学习，释放后，能召唤出一尊药鼎，要来炼制药物，持续时间十分钟，期间，每五秒分别消耗六点HP和MP。
如今，紫罗幻灵香晋升一阶后领悟的技能中，只有“药鼎幻身”是属于药师玩家“聂空”的。
“其他技能数据看来是真的都丢失了。”
聂空嘀咕道。
不过这样也好，像疗伤术和聚元术、固体术之类的技能，就算领悟了也不用不了，聂空现在是个真实的人，并不是游戏里的玩家数据，没有HP值，没有MP值，也没有防御值，怎么给自己加血加蓝加防御？
倒是“药鼎幻身”这个炼药技能，想来用得上，就不知现在它的功能是不是还和游戏中那样？
“啊呀呀。”
香香换着叶子甜甜地叫着，一道意识来到聂空脑中。
药鼎幻身：宠物“香香”幻化成一尊药鼎，辅助主人炼药，持续时间三十分钟，每次使用后，宠物“香香”需休息十二小时。
“十二小时一次，一天可用两次，倒是不错。”
聂空微微一笑，在这天灵大陆使用“药鼎幻身”，无需消耗HP和MP，真正耗费的应该是香香的精力，也即是药力。要是没有足够的药力供紫罗幻灵香吸收，小家伙病恹恹的精力不足，自然无法幻化药鼎。
压下尝试召唤药鼎的冲动，聂空将注意力转移到另外那个技能上来。
花爆：宠物‘香香’九阶技能‘花山血海’的初始形态，需主人和宠物‘香香’共同施展。
九阶技能，花山血海！
对于这个技能，聂空再熟悉不过了，它可是终极BOSS紫罗幻灵香的绝招之一。他曾在妖魔的官网论坛看过好几个打BOSS的视频，其中就有紫罗幻灵香一个“花山血海”、将数十名高级玩家瞬间秒杀的场景。初看的时候，聂空还只有六十多级，当时着实让他震撼了一把。
花山血海的初始技能形态，想来差不到哪里去！
可惜，在这里，不可能像在妖魔游戏里那样，想要使用什么技能，直接释放出来就是。如今，想要真正将“花爆”和“药鼎幻身”这两种技能熟练运用，恐怕还得好好修炼，好好与香香磨合。
“先学哪个好呢？”
脑子里想着花爆和药鼎幻身，聂空捏着下巴，喃喃自语。好半晌过后，聂空打定主意正要行动，忽地想起一个被自己遗忘的东西，不由“啪”的一拍自己脑袋：“怎么把它给忘记了？”

宠物背包四格！
在妖魔游戏里，收养的宠物都会有背包，不过一般来说，三格就是极限了，只有极少数极品宠物，才可能有四格背包。
“宠物背包。”
聂空心中默念道。
瞬即，意识中出现了一块白蒙蒙的区域，里面中央处有小片透明空间，约莫有四立方米左右。
看来一格宠物背包就是一立方了。
和小家伙沟通了下，聂空才明白这片小空间可以存放任何非生命物体，只要能放得下。眼睛在房间里一扫，看到桌面那包裹金针的白布包时，立时有了目标，于是，聂空将自己的注意力全部集中在它上面。
不到两秒，那布包诡异地从桌面消失，静悄悄地躺在了宠物背包里。
“好东西，跟传说中的空间戒指差不多。”
聂空大喜，据他所知，天灵大陆似乎并没有这样的物品，现在有了宠物背包，想偷什么就偷什么东西，只要小心点，绝不会被人发现，真是盗贼的神器哪！阿米豆腐啊，罪过，罪过！
化身假和尚，戏谑地暗念了声佛号，聂空意念一起，白布包从宠物背包转移到了桌面。几秒后，布包再次回到宠物背包。
聂空像是得到漂亮玩具的小孩子，乐此不疲地当起了搬运工。于是，还没过去一分钟，聂空便头脑晕呼呼的，像条死狗般倒在床上，咧着嘴直喘气，真费神呐，搬运工也不是那么好当的。

Chapter 13: Medicine Cauldron Phantom Body
There was a faint fragrance floating in the room, and under the orange light, a beautiful woman with a hot figure danced passionately to the music. The breasts are perky, the waist is swinging, and the tall and graceful body is twisting gracefully like a water snake. The beauty of the concave and convex shapes is looming under the pink gauze.
The music gradually becomes softer, and the ambiguous atmosphere full of temptation lingers.
Looking at this beautiful woman who had just returned from a hookup in the bar, Nie Kong was very interested and made a squeezing gesture towards her breasts. The beauty giggled coquettishly, danced and came to Nie Kong's body, spread her slender legs, and actually sat astride Nie Kong's thigh.
The plump breasts brushed against Nie Kong's chest from time to time, and moans came out of the beauty's fiery red lips.
"It's a little devil who is so charming that he won't pay for his life."
The beauty's scream was like an aphrodisiac, and Nie Kong's reaction became more intense. He couldn't help but growl and push the beauty down on the bed. But just when he transformed into a beast and was about to execute the beauty, his sexy and enchanting body suddenly flashed, and the next moment, the beauty turned into a pure and beautiful girl with a sarong skirt and wooden hairpin.
"Uncle?"
The beautiful girl's face was red, and her watery eyes were full of panic and shyness. She seemed to be asking why Nie Kong had become such a beast.
"Sister-in-law? Huamei?"
Taking a closer look, Nie Kong was so frightened that he suddenly turned over and jumped up as if being kissed by a snake. In a blink of an eye, he found that he was sitting on the bed. There was a white light in the window, and the room was full of shadows. The shadows of tables and chairs could be vaguely distinguished. It was the bedroom he had in Nie's house.
I actually had an erotic dream. It seems like my life in this other world has been too stressful these days! Nie Kong rubbed his eyes, smiled bitterly and shook his head.
Suddenly, a "dinging bell" rang in his mind, and a very mechanical voice came out: "The pet 'Purple Phantom Spirit Fragrance' has been successfully upgraded to the first level. The four slots of the pet backpack have been activated. The first-level homogeneous combat skill 'Hanabao' has been mastered, and the homogeneous auxiliary skill 'Medicine Cauldron Phantom Body' has been mastered."
Has Xiangxiang been upgraded?
Nie Kong was startled, and with a thought, the situation in the "Yaochi Point" between the three spiritual orifices suddenly appeared in his mind: the seed of Ziluo Magic Spirit Fragrance had grown into a small seedling, with three small whiskers at the bottom respectively attached to the orifices, and a small leaf on the thin stem, which was light green with a faint purple.
Under Nie Kong's "watching", the little guy happily shook the only small leaf, and a vigorous vitality spread out.
"Little guys grow up fast."
Nie Kong looked surprised.
The little guy fell into a deep sleep after absorbing a large amount of medicinal power the day before yesterday, and there was no movement after that. Nie Kong thought it had absorbed too much and was being stretched, causing problems. He had been a little worried. Unexpectedly, two days later, when the little guy woke up again, he had been upgraded to the first level.
After being happy for a while, Nie Kong recalled the voice in his mind just now.
According to the standards of monsters, the first level should be the tenth level. First-level skills should be skills between level 10 and level 20.
There are four first-level skills for the pharmacist profession: Healing, Yuan Gathering, Solidity, and Sky-Breaking Slash. The Healing Technique is used to restore HP; the Yuan Gathering Technique can consume a small amount of HP to instantly replenish MP; the Solid Technique can increase one's defense; and the Air Splitting Slash is the only attack skill before the pharmacist's level 20. As for the "Medicine Cauldron Illusion Body", it comes from the life occupation "Medicine Refining". It can be learned at level 10. After releasing it, it can summon a medicine cauldron to refine medicine. It lasts for ten minutes. During this period, six points of HP and MP are consumed every five seconds.
Nowadays, among the skills that Ziluo Phantom Spirit has learned after being promoted to the first level, only "Medicine Cauldron Phantom Body" belongs to the pharmacist player "Nie Kong".
"It seems that other skill data are really lost."
Nie Kong muttered.
But this is fine, like healing and Yuan gathering., Solid Technique and other skills, even if you master them, you can't use them. Nie Kong is now a real person, not a player data in the game. He has no HP value, no MP value, and no defense value. How can he add blood, blue, and defense to himself?
On the other hand, the medicine refining skill "Medicine Cauldron Phantom Body" is useful, but I wonder if its function is still the same as in the game?
"Ahhhhh."
Xiangxiang cried sweetly as its leaves changed, and a consciousness came to Nie Kong's mind.
Medicine Cauldron: The pet "Xiangxiang" transforms into a medicine cauldron to assist the owner in refining medicine. It lasts for thirty minutes. After each use, the pet "Xiangxiang" needs to rest for twelve hours.
"Once every twelve hours, you can use it twice a day, which is pretty good."
Nie Kong smiled slightly. Using the "Medicine Cauldron Illusion Body" in this Tianling Continent does not need to consume HP and MP. What really consumes should be Xiangxiang's energy, that is, the power of the medicine. If there is not enough medicinal power for the purple phantom incense to absorb, the sickly little guy will naturally be unable to transform into a medicinal cauldron due to lack of energy.
Suppressing the urge to try to summon the medicine cauldron, Nie Kong turned his attention to the other skill.
Hua Bang: The initial form of pet ‘Xiang Xiang’’s ninth-level skill ‘Hua Shan Xue Hai’, which needs to be performed by the owner and pet ‘Xiang Xiang’ together.
Ninth-level skills, mountains of flowers and seas of blood!
Nie Kong is very familiar with this skill. It is one of the ultimate BOSS Ziluo Phantom Incense's unique skills. He had seen several BOSS-fighting videos on the official website forum of the demon, including the scene where Ziluo Huanlingxiang killed dozens of high-level players in a "mountain of flowers and sea of ​​blood" in an instant. When he first saw it, Nie Kong was only at level sixty, which really shocked him.
The initial skill form of Huashan Blood Sea is almost the same as expected!
Unfortunately, here, it is impossible to directly release whatever skills you want to use like in the monster game. Nowadays, if you want to truly master the two skills of "Hua Bang" and "Medicine Cauldron Illusion Body", you probably have to practice hard and get along well with Xiangxiang.
"Which one should I learn first?"
Thinking about Huabang and Yaoding's phantom body in his mind, Nie Kong pinched his chin and muttered to himself. After a long while, Nie Kong made up his mind and was about to take action when he suddenly remembered something he had forgotten and couldn't help but slap his head: "Why did you forget it?"
Pet backpack with four compartments!
In the monster game, all adopted pets will have backpacks, but generally speaking, three spaces is the limit. Only a very small number of top-quality pets may have four-space backpacks.
"Pet backpack."
Nie Kong thought silently in his heart.
Instantly, a white area appeared in his consciousness, with a small transparent space in the center, about four cubic meters in size.
It seems that one pet backpack is one cubic meter.
After communicating with the little guy, Nie Kong realized that this small space could store any inanimate objects as long as they could fit. His eyes swept around the room, and when he saw the white cloth bag wrapped with gold needles on the table, he immediately had a target, so Nie Kong focused all his attention on it.
In less than two seconds, the cloth bag mysteriously disappeared from the table and lay quietly in the pet backpack.
"It's a good thing. It's similar to the legendary space ring."
Nie Kong was overjoyed. As far as he knew, there seemed to be no such item in Tianling Continent. Now that he had a pet backpack, he could steal whatever he wanted. As long as he was careful, he would never be discovered. It was really a magical weapon for thieves! Ami tofu, sin, sin!
Transforming into a fake monk, he jokingly recited the Buddha's name secretly, and Nie Kong thought together, and the white cloth bag was transferred from the pet backpack to the table. After a few seconds, the cloth bag returned to the pet backpack again.
Nie Kong was like a child who got a beautiful toy and happily became a porter. So, before a minute passed, Nie Kong felt dizzy and fell on the bed like a dead dog, grinning.Panting, it’s really tiring, porters are not that easy to do.
